title: When were they there?
translation: 他们是什么时候在那里的？
description: A bilingual lesson built around 18 dated illustrations in three rows — days of the week (stationer's, greengrocer, hairdresser, butcher, grocer, dairy), dates (church, school, the office, the baker's, home, the butcher's) and months (Australia, Austria, Canada, China, Denmark, Finland) — that practise 'When were they there?' with at/on/in. Includes workbook time- and place-classification with at/on/in and was/wasn't/were/weren't dialogues, plus grammar on there was/were questions and preposition fill-ins. 以三行共18幅带日期插图为主的双语课——星期（文具店、蔬果店、理发店、肉铺、杂货店、乳品店）、日期（教堂、学校、办公室、面包店、家、肉铺）和月份（澳大利亚、奥地利、加拿大、中国、丹麦、芬兰）——练习 at/on/in 的「他们什么时候在那里？」句型。配合教材时间/地点分类（at/on/in）和 was/wasn't/were/weren't 对话练习，以及 there was/were 问句和介词填空的语法练习。
answer_note: Workbook A (time and place classification) answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 70 key (img/key-067-072.jpg). Workbook B (structure dialogues) item 1 is a printed example; the remaining answers follow the printed example pattern and the given cues and are labelled suggested. Textbook written-exercise A answers are constructed from standard English usage and the printed example and labelled suggested; written-exercise B follows the two printed examples and is labelled suggested. Grammar I and II answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 70 grammar key (PDF viewer page 501); items marked as printed examples are not editable. No external sources were used.

lesson.text:
Listen and answer the questions.
听录音并回答问题。

When were they there? 他们是什么时候在那里的？
lesson.translation: Listen and answer the questions. When were they there?

lesson.title: Written exercise A Complete these sentences using at, on or in.
lesson.instruction: Complete these sentences using at, on or in. 完成以下句子，用适当的介词填空。
lesson.translation: Fill in each blank with at, on or in.
lesson.context: No official key is supplied; answers are constructed from standard English usage (at + time/clock, on + day/date, in + month/season/year/country) and labelled suggested.

questions.prompt: We were ______ the stationer's ______ Monday.
questions.answer:
at
on

questions.prompt: We were there ______ four o'clock.
questions.answer: at

questions.prompt: They were ______ Australia ______ September.
questions.answer:
in
in

questions.prompt: They were there ______ spring.
questions.answer: in

questions.prompt: ______ November 25th, they were ______ Canada.
questions.answer:
On
in

questions.prompt: They were there ______ 1990.
questions.answer: in

lesson.title: Written exercise B Write questions and answers using we/they and at/in/on.
lesson.instruction: Write questions and answers using we/they and at/in/on. 模仿例句提问并回答，选用 we 或 they 作主语，介词可选用 at, in 或 on。
lesson.translation: Write a question and a full answer for each set of cues, following the printed examples.
lesson.context: The two printed examples (Sam and Penny/the stationer's/Monday → Where were Sam and Penny on Monday? They were at the stationer's on Monday.; you and Penny/Australia/July → Where were you and Penny in July? We were in Australia in July.) are not editable. Items 1-8 follow the same pattern; the question and answer are each one field.

questions.prompt: Sam and Penny/the stationer's/Monday
questions.answer:
Where were Sam and Penny on Monday?
They were at the stationer's on Monday.

questions.prompt: you and Penny/Australia/July
questions.answer:
Where were you and Penny in July?
We were in Australia in July.

questions.prompt: you and Susan/the office/March 23rd
questions.answer:
Where were you and Susan on March 23rd?
We were in the office on March 23rd.

questions.prompt: Sam and Penny/India/1986
questions.answer:
Where were Sam and Penny in 1986?
They were in India in 1986.

questions.prompt: you and Penny/the baker's/Saturday
questions.answer:
Where were you and Penny on Saturday?
We were at the baker's on Saturday.

questions.prompt: Sam and Penny/Canada/1993
questions.answer:
Where were Sam and Penny in 1993?
They were in Canada in 1993.

questions.prompt: you and Penny/Austria/August
questions.answer:
Where were you and Penny in August?
We were in Austria in August.

questions.prompt: Sam and Penny/home/May 25th
questions.answer:
Where were Sam and Penny on May 25th?
They were at home on May 25th.

questions.prompt: you and Penny/Finland/December
questions.answer:
Where were you and Penny in December?
We were in Finland in December.

questions.prompt: you and Sam/school/February 22nd
questions.answer:
Where were you and Sam on February 22nd?
We were at school on February 22nd.

practice.title: A Prepositions of time and place — 1 (times)
practice.instruction: Put these times (days, months, dates, years) in the correct box with on or in. 将下列表示时间的词和短语列入正确的介词栏目中。
practice.translation: Classify each time expression under 'on' or 'in'.
practice.context: The word bank is: November 1989, August 1st, July 1st, October 26th, January, Wednesday, 1989, Tuesday, June, September, 1952, Saturday 1975, February 16th. The key lists: on → July 1st, October 26th, Saturday, February 16th, Tuesday, January; in → August, January, 1975, June, September, 1952. Each box is one answer field.

questions.prompt: Put each time expression in the correct box: on / in.
questions.answer:
on: July 1st, October 26th, Saturday, February 16th, Tuesday, January
in: August, January, 1975, June, September, 1952

practice.title: A Prepositions of time and place — 2 (places)
practice.instruction: Put these places (countries, shops, etc.) in the correct box with at or in. 将下列表示地点的词和短语列入正确的介词栏目中。
practice.context: The word bank is: Australia, home, the baker's, China, the dairy, Canada, the hairdresser's, India, the greengrocer's, France, the office, the butcher's, Turkey, Japan. The key lists: at → the baker's, the dairy, the hairdresser's, the greengrocer's, church, the office, the butcher's, home, the stationer's; in → China, Canada, India, France, Turkey, Japan.

questions.prompt: Put each place in the correct box: at / in.
questions.answer:
at: the baker's, the dairy, the hairdresser's, the greengrocer's, the office, the butcher's, home, the stationer's
in: China, Canada, India, France, Turkey, Japan, Australia

practice.title: B Structure
practice.instruction: Write dialogues like the example. Use was, wasn't, were or weren't. 仿照例句完成以下对话，使用 was, wasn't, were 或 weren't。
practice.translation: Write a question and a full answer for each set of cues, following the printed example.
practice.context: Item 1 is a printed example and is not editable. The remaining items follow the same pattern; the question and answer are each one field. No official key is supplied; answers are constructed from the printed example and the given cues and labelled suggested.

questions.prompt: Sam / Monday / church?
questions.answer: Where was Sam on Monday? Was he at church?

questions.prompt: your father / 1996 / England?
questions.answer: Where was your father in 1996? Was he in England?

questions.prompt: you / March 1st / school?
questions.answer: Where were you on March 1st? Were you at school?

questions.prompt: they / November / Austria?
questions.answer: Where were they in November? Were they in Austria?

questions.prompt: Jill / Wednesday / the office?
questions.answer: Where was Jill on Wednesday? Was she at the office?

questions.prompt: Mr. and Mrs. Johnson / the weekend / home?
questions.answer: Where were Mr. and Mrs. Johnson at the weekend? Were they at home?

questions.prompt: Were there any apples at the greengrocer's on Saturday? (yes)
questions.answer: Yes, there were. There were some apples there on Saturday.

questions.prompt: Were there any oranges at the greengrocer's on Sunday? (no)
questions.answer: No, there weren't. There weren't any oranges there on Sunday.

questions.prompt: Were there any people in the building on July 11th? (yes)
questions.answer: Yes, there were. There were some people there on July 11th.

questions.prompt: Were there any boys in the room on Wednesday? (no)
questions.answer: No, there weren't. There weren't any boys there on Wednesday.

questions.prompt: Were there any tins in the cupboard on Saturday? (no)
questions.answer: No, there weren't. There weren't any tins there on Saturday.

questions.prompt: Were there any students at school on June 1st? (yes)
questions.answer: Yes, there were. There were some students there on June 1st.

questions.prompt: Were there any good cars in the race on June 30th? (yes)
questions.answer: Yes, there were. There were some good cars there on June 30th.

questions.prompt: Was there any sugar in the packet on Tuesday? (yes)
questions.answer: Yes, there was. There was some sugar in the packet on Tuesday.

questions.prompt: Was there any mince at the butcher's on Friday? (no)
questions.answer: No, there wasn't. There wasn't any mince at the butcher's on Friday.

questions.prompt: Was there any butter in the refrigerator last week? (yes)
questions.answer: Yes, there was. There was some butter in the refrigerator last week.

questions.prompt: Was there any tea at the grocer's on Monday? (no)
questions.answer: No, there wasn't. There wasn't any tea at the grocer's on Monday.

questions.prompt: Was there any milk at the dairy on Thursday? (yes)
questions.answer: Yes, there was. There was some milk at the dairy on Thursday.

questions.prompt: Was there any soap in the bathroom on Sunday? (yes)
questions.answer: Yes, there was. There was some soap in the bathroom on Sunday.

questions.prompt: Was there any writing paper and ink at the stationer's on Tuesday? (no)
questions.answer: No, there wasn't. There wasn't any writing paper and ink at the stationer's on Tuesday.
